home.title: Who's learning today?
home.subtitle: Tap your name to carry on where you stopped.

hero.description: A free social-studies course. Learn about people, places and communities, and share your own ideas.
hero.footnote: {lessons} lessons in {sections} sections · no account needed

home.lookAroundNote: Work is saved on this device only. No passwords, no photos.

newLearner.nameRequired: Tell us what to call you.
newLearner.classCodeHelper: Your teacher may give you one.
newLearner.classCodeInvalid: Use letters, numbers and hyphens only, like HLP-07.
newLearner.startsWithNote: You can open any lesson later from the course page.
newLearner.privacyNote: Your work stays on this device.

remove.label: Remove {name}
remove.confirmBody: This deletes their progress, quiz results and recordings from this device. It cannot be undone.

noStorage.title: Your work can't be saved on this device
noStorage.body: This browser is blocking on-device storage, often in a private window. You can still look around, but nothing you do will be saved.

guest.title: Explore the course
guest.body: You're looking around, so nothing you do here is saved.

dashboard.summaryNone: You haven't started a lesson yet. Next up is Lesson {number}.

dashboard.summaryDone: You have finished every lesson. Well done.
dashboard.continueEyebrow: Pick up where you left off

sectionCheckBody.other: You finished all {count} lessons. Try {questions} questions to see what you remember. Take it as many times as you like.

dashboard.noJournalYet: Nothing saved yet. Your writing and reflections show up here once you start.

course.title: Exploring Our World
course.description: Discover how people, places, communities and decisions shape the world around us.
course.nothingLocked: Nothing is locked. Start any lesson, in any order. The numbers show a good path.
course.guestNote: You're looking around, so progress isn't shown.
course.noLearnerNote: Choose who's learning to see your progress.

notFound.body: The link may be old or have a typo. Everything in the course is still here.

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.body: Sorry about that. Try reloading the page, or go back to home. Nothing you had saved is lost.
